title: Start bounded Foundation source GREEN with net10/net11 exact public contract parity and two copied-source refusals
commitMessage: test: qualify isolated Math Foundation cross-SDK parity and contract refusals

contribution.summary: Activate bounded migration GREEN with a source-only Foundation public-contract oracle on SDK 10 and SDK 11, preserving the unqualified product-wide migration boundary.
contribution.value: RS328 succeeded first-pass with DWF 0.1.72 and guidance 0.27, closing migration RED and readying C02/T1 GREEN. RS329 selects the real one-file dw.tools.math.foundation source project with no project dependencies. A Math-owned C# harness creates separate short-path offline net10/C#14 and net11/C#15 consumers from identical source bytes. Both must select their correct SDK, compile, execute and return identical public PackageId/ContractVersion/Identity values. On only the copied net11 source, contract-version and package-identity drift must be rejected, then restored copies must again pass. Original SDK pins, source files, official delta matrix and migration blocker remain hash-stable. This qualifies Foundation source retargeting only: no C#15 new syntax, published Foundation archive, full numerical semantics, other twelve libraries or migration approval is inferred.
debtChanges: RS328 succeeded first-pass at attempt 001 with DWF 0.1.72, completed migration RED and readied C02/T1 GREEN without modifying SDK, packages or source.
RS329 reuses existing FoundationContract public API and historical net11 source proof as a basis for a new, bounded exact net10/net11 differential consumer.
Two mutations to only the copied net11 source must fail the public identity oracle, then byte-exact source restoration and clean execution must succeed.
Keep 13 semantic/API compatibility verdicts and ten published NuGet closures unqualified; global.json SDK10, net10/C#14, private archives and guidance 0.27 unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: After source-only Foundation parity succeeds, assess further bounded GREEN evidence and independent consumer needs before closing C02/T1 GREEN; do not assert production net11 migration authorization.
